diagrams.title: 3.1a - Account access
diagrams.notes: U1 creates ordinary human accounts with MFA enrollment. Admin is pre-provisioned. Merchant clients use separate client authentication, not human login/MFA.
diagrams.provenance: Newly authored from approved MVP plan; no old diagram input

diagrams.title: 3.1b - Shared escrow-party actions
diagrams.notes: Merchant uses U4.API for its own client escrows only. U8 accepted refund invokes P3; an open dispute invalidates a pending refund proposal. No merchant refund/dispute authority.
diagrams.provenance: Newly authored from approved MVP plan; no old diagram input

diagrams.title: 3.1c - Buyer journey
diagrams.notes: B1.API reuses B1 with seller-bound client authorization. P2 is a referenced reusable payment use case. B4 always invokes P2 after its state guard accepts the release decision.
diagrams.provenance: Newly authored from approved MVP plan; no old diagram input

diagrams.title: 3.1d - Seller journey
diagrams.notes: Seller accepts terms before funding. S2 records goods delivery or service completion and required evidence; it never proves payment completion or automatically releases funds.
diagrams.provenance: Newly authored from approved MVP plan; no old diagram input

diagrams.title: 3.1e - Administration
diagrams.notes: A1 accepts one reasoned full-release or full-refund decision and invokes P2 or P3. A5 queries unknown outcomes and retries only confirmed failures; it cannot manually mark a transfer successful.
diagrams.provenance: Newly authored from approved MVP plan; no old diagram input

diagrams.title: 3.1f - Payment integration
diagrams.notes: P1 confirms actual mock receipt. P2 releases via Bank mock. P3 refunds through the original funding provider/source. Buyer/Admin decisions initiate P2/P3 indirectly; no internal EPS actor is invented.
diagrams.provenance: Newly authored from approved MVP plan; no old diagram input
